objective: Implement parseJSON(text), a strict bounded JSON parser with explicit duplicate-key and numeric-range policy. Return plain JavaScript source defining parseJSON.

requirements.text: parseJSON(text) accepts exactly one JSON value with optional JSON whitespace (space, tab, LF, CR); rejects malformed syntax, trailing input, comments, unquoted keys, trailing commas, leading zeroes, NaN/Infinity and non-string inputs by throwing an Error.

Decode all JSON string escapes and four-hex-digit Unicode escapes using JavaScript UTF-16 semantics (including surrogate pairs and individual escaped surrogate code units); reject raw control characters and malformed escapes.
Parse arrays and objects recursively; reject duplicate object keys after escape decoding; preserve keys including __proto__ and constructor as own enumerable data properties.
Parse JSON number grammar using IEEE-754 semantics; reject non-finite parsed results or absolute value greater than 9007199254740991. Negative zero is permitted.
Accept input strings of at most 65536 UTF-16 code units and container nesting depth at most 32; count each array/object as one container level; reject larger input or depth by throwing an Error.
